channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: ‘Long Live Liberty, Damn It!’: Foreign Leaders Respond To Trump’s Capture Of Socialist Dictator Nicolás Maduro
item.description: A range of reactions from world leaders poured in Saturday morning after President Donald Trump announced the capture and indictment of Venezuelan socialist dictator Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: Senior Democrat, Bucking Party’s Knee-Jerking Reaction, Praises Trump’s Capture Of ‘Illegitimate’ Maduro
item.description: Rep. Debbie Wasserman Schultz, a South Florida Democrat with a sizable Venezuelan population in her district, bucked her party Saturday to praise President Donald Trump's capture of socialist dictator Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: Trump Hints Which Dictator Could Be Next After Toppling Maduro
item.description: President Donald Trump warned brutal world leaders such as Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel during a Saturday press conference that what happened to Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro could happen to them.

item.title: Trump Bursts Bubble On Nobel Prize-Winning Machado’s Vision For Taking Power In Venezuela
item.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday he doubted that Nobel laureate María Corina Machado's wishes for who could succeed deposed Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro could come to pass.

item.title: Scathing Indictment Claims Nicolás Maduro Orchestrated Drug-Fueled ‘Culture Of Corruption’ Which Plagued Entire Region
item.description: Ousted socialist Venezuelan dictator Nicolás Maduro was the mastermind of a pervasive drug-fueled "culture of corruption" which extended all the way to the U.S.'s backyard, according to the scathing indictment against him, his wife, his son, and others, released Saturday.

item.title: MAGA World Speaks Out On Trump’s Maduro Operation
item.description: The operation ordered by President Donald Trump which led to Saturday's capture of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro drew support across the Make America Great Again movement.

item.title: Photos Show Behind-The-Scenes Tension, Focus As Trump Orders Military Operation To Venezuela
item.description: 'President Donald Trump and his team, in a flurry of social media activity Saturday, posted behind-the-scenes photos and videos depicting the morning's successful military operation to capture and remove Venezuelan socialist dictator Nicolás Maduro.'

item.title: DAVID BLACKMON: AI Firms Should Buckle Up For Regulatory Assault
item.description: How should AI be regulated, and who gets to decide? These are questions that seem certain to become dominant stories throughout 2026.

item.title: Bukele Dismisses Sen. Van Hollen’s 204-Word Rebuke Of Trump’s Venezuela Op With Just Seven Words
item.description: El Salvador President Nayib Bukele gave a seven-word response Saturday to a lengthy statement by a Democratic U.S. senator condemning the Trump administration's capture and overthrow of socialist Venezuelan dictator Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: LEIF LARSON: Netflix-Warner Bros Deal All About Consumer Value
item.description: Like so many Americans who have partially pulled the plug on traditional TV, I am a streaming fan and love Netflix. Netflix has evolved from a DVD rental service into an entertainment powerhouse, revolutionizing how we consume stories.
